test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All schools are colleges.

No college is a university.

Conclusions:

(I): No school is a university.

(II): All colleges are schools.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
**Statements:**

All schools are colleges.

No college is a university.

The least possible venn diagram is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76df180c39d2ac9c50ae898c9b1883e45ee9bd408844fa0ae15d2b8840d52f47.png] 

**Conclusions**:

(I): No school is a university - **True**(All school is colleges and no college is university, it implies that no school is university).

(II): All colleges are schools - **False**(because, All school is colleges, it implies that some colleges are schools, so it can be possible only).

Thus, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
